{{StoryArc|Dare to Believe|Shining Star|Faction Chip Event}} {{Quotes|That's "Auto-Fight", but it's not as good as taking control yourself. A bit of practice and you can get remarkably skilled with these simple inputs.

I'd probably just mash all the buttons until I won or broke something.| Mirage teaching Ultra Magnus how to control his hologram, and Blaster's response.}} '''Training Montage''' is a standalone [[Spotlight Mission]] that ran from July 28th ~ August 11th, 2022. == Synopsis == ''Mirage has made some interesting improvements on his invisibility tech, now he can project "perfect" copies of his Autobot friends! The tech is still in the testing phase but he wants the Commander to train alongside some Autobot pals as he figures it out. To keep spirits up, Blaster is also on site to ensure that there’s some terrific tunes for this TRAINING MONTAGE.'' == Transcript == === Chapter One: Cue the Music=== ==== Mission One: The Best Around==== ==== Mission Two: Separate Ways==== ==== Mission Three: No Easy Way Out==== ==Gallery== File:Training Montage 1.jpg File:Training Montage 2.jpg File:Training Montage 3.jpg File:Training Montage 4.jpg File:Training Montage newsfeed.jpg File:Training Montage newsfeed banner.jpg File:Training Montage chapter 1.jpg File:Training Montage header.png File:Training Montage mail.jpg File:Training Montage complete.jpg == Trivia ==
